{'據了解，今次係海關同國安警嘅聯合行動，海關較早前喺一批寄到香港嘅貨物入面，發現具煽動意圖嘅書籍，今日到兩間書店搜查。': 'It is understood that this operation is a joint action by Customs and national security police. Customs earlier discovered books with seditious intent in a shipment of goods addressed to Hong Kong, and today searched two bookstores.'}

{'據了解，昨日（14日）宣布會喺8點半結業嘅留下書舍，今早（15日）有警察上門調查。留下書舍嘅窗口，下午已經拉起百頁簾。有出版社人員到該棟大廈送貨，被查驗證件，其後獲放行。': "It is understood that Lau Cha Bookstore, which yesterday (the 14th) announced it would close at 8:30pm, was visited by police for investigation this morning (the 15th). By the afternoon, the blinds at the bookstore's window had already been drawn. A publishing company staff member went to the building to deliver goods, had their identification checked by police, and was subsequently allowed to leave."}

{'大約5點50分，警方將一名女店員押上警車，女店員身穿黑衣，衫上面寫住「我係書店店員」，佢被鎖上手銬押走。警方行動結束之後，書店外面嘅電影海報仍然喺度，書店鎖上鐵閘，門外海報印有「活得真誠磊落」幾隻字。書店窗口一幅有前後「自由」、「風雨」字眼嘅毛巾被移走。': 'At around 5:50pm, police escorted a female shop assistant onto a police vehicle. The shop assistant, dressed in black, was wearing a shirt that read "I am a bookstore employee," and was taken away in handcuffs. After the police operation ended, the movie posters outside the bookstore remained, and the bookstore was locked with a steel gate. The poster outside the door was printed with the words "Live with sincerity and integrity." A towel bearing the words "Freedom" and "Wind and Rain" on its front and back was removed from the bookstore window.'}

{'另一間獨立書店田園書屋，據了解亦被警方搜查。下午4點半左右，警方帶走一名男子，另搬走四個藍色膠箱同一個黑色行李箱。': 'Another independent bookstore, Tin Yuen Bookstore, was also reportedly searched by police. At around 4:30pm, police took away a man and also removed four blue plastic crates and a black suitcase.'}

{'今日約下午一時，幾名便衣警察去到太子嘅留下書舍搜查，期間有便衣警察帶住藍色膠箱上樓，大約兩個鐘之後，警察著上印有「police」嘅背心，有出版社人員送貨上樓，遭警方搜查，其後獲放行。下午不時有市民上樓剪頭髮或者返工，如常通行，並無遭警方截查。': 'At around 1pm today, several plainclothes police officers went to Lau Cha Bookstore in Prince Edward to conduct a search. During the operation, some plainclothes officers carried blue plastic crates upstairs. About two hours later, police put on vests printed with "Police." A publishing company staff member delivering goods upstairs was searched by police and subsequently allowed to leave. In the afternoon, members of the public went upstairs from time to time to get haircuts or go to work, passing through as usual without being stopped and searched by police.'}

{'2022年開業嘅留下書舍，由資深傳媒人岑蘊華同幾位前傳媒人創立，主打同新聞題材有關嘅書籍，亦有舉辦讀書分享會等活動。近月國安警先後對一拳書館、獵人書店等採取拘捕行動，留下書舍昨日喺社交媒體發表結業預告，表示最近嘅事態，可能係駱駝背上最後一根稻草，難以捉摸嘅紅線，亦係一個結業原因。佢哋喺聲明指，局長之前明言唔會交代咩書唔可以賣，而書店「無能力判斷咩書先係『有問題』。」': 'Lau Cha Bookstore, which opened in 2022, was founded by veteran media practitioner Shum Wan-wah and several former media professionals, focusing primarily on books related to journalism and also holding book-sharing sessions and other activities. In recent months, national security police have successively taken arrest actions against bookstores including One Punch Bookstore and Hunter Bookstore. Yesterday, Lau Cha Bookstore posted a closure notice on social media, stating that recent developments may have been the final straw that broke the camel\'s back, and that the elusive red line was also a reason for closing. In their statement, they pointed out that the Secretary had previously stated explicitly that no explanation would be given as to which books cannot be sold, and that the bookstore "has no ability to determine which books are \'problematic\'."'}

{'今年陸續有獨立書店捲入國安案件，亦有獨立書店被貿發局取消參展資格。今年三月，一拳書館負責人龐一鳴及三名職員被國安警拘捕，四人被指涉及23條下嘅「明知而出售具煽動意圖刊物」罪，書店內嘅《黎智英傳》等被檢走。龐一鳴早前亦因書館舉辦西班牙文興趣班被控違反《教育條例》，遭罰款3.2萬元。去年六月舉辦棟篤笑舞台表演，被控「無牌公眾娛樂場所罪」，違反《公眾娛樂場所條例》，佢同公司各被判罰3000元，合共罰款6000元。': 'This year, independent bookstores have continued to be embroiled in national security cases, and some have had their exhibition qualifications revoked by the HKTDC. In March this year, One Punch Bookstore operator Pong Yat-ming and three staff members were arrested by national security police. The four were alleged to have committed the offence of "selling publications with seditious intent while knowing such intent" under Article 23, and books including a biography of Jimmy Lai were seized from the bookstore. Pong Yat-ming was also previously charged with violating the Education Ordinance for the bookstore running a Spanish language interest class and was fined HK$32,000. A stand-up comedy stage performance held last June led to charges of "operating an unlicensed place of public entertainment," in violation of the Places of Public Entertainment Ordinance. He and his company were each fined HK$3,000, totalling HK$6,000 in fines.'}

{'今年6月29日，獵人書店創辦人黃文萱夫婦被國安警以涉嫌違反23條下嘅「出於煽動意圖作出具煽動意圖作為」罪，以及涉嫌洗黑錢等罪名拘捕。數日後，傳出榆林書店及樂文書店突然遭貿發局取消參加香港書展嘅消息。會展嘅書展係獨立書店一年嘅重要收入來源。據知書店亦準備咗大批書本，突然遭貿發局DQ，兩間書店都要減價清貨，榆林書店喺上周宣布，明年四月租約期滿，將會「光榮結束門市」。': 'On 29 June this year, Hunter Bookstore founder Wong Man-huen and her husband were arrested by national security police on suspicion of committing the offence of "doing acts with seditious intent out of seditious intent" under Article 23, as well as money laundering and other charges. A few days later, news emerged that Elm Tree Bookstore and Lok Man Bookstore had been suddenly disqualified by the HKTDC from participating in the Hong Kong Book Fair. The Book Fair at the Convention and Exhibition Centre is an important annual source of income for independent bookstores. It is understood the bookstores had also prepared large quantities of books, and being suddenly disqualified by the HKTDC meant both had to clear stock at discounted prices. Elm Tree Bookstore announced last week that with its lease expiring next April, it would "gloriously close its physical store."'}
